name: OpenSmell Vial Index
description: Installable domain Vials for Osmograph. Fetch this index to list and install Vials without a server.

vials.name: Indoor Air Quality
vials.author: @opensmell
vials.tagline: Live indoor air context from the sensors you actually have.
vials.summary: An indoor air quality workspace for rigs with CO2, VOC, temperature, humidity, or particulate channels. Advisory only — not a certified AQI monitor.

vials.name: Calibration & QA
vials.author: @opensmell
vials.tagline: Guided sensor calibration and quality assurance.
vials.summary: Walks through zero/span calibration per channel, validates sensor health, and exports a clean calibration report. Advisory only — not a certified calibration service.

note: Add your own Vials to this index by hosting a manifest JSON and UI HTML, then adding an entry here. Osmograph verifies every manifest through its local gate before install. Link only — never rehost restrictive datasets.
